verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an Export API for project event data, and its integrations directory lists Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks. Third-party pipelines such as Fivetran and Hightouch are also listed. However, the warehouse entries are only generic vendor blurbs: they don't say which direction data flows, whether export is continuous, or whether warehouse tables can be queried inside Amplitude. missing for 10: documented continuous/scheduled event export to warehouses, in-product querying of warehouse tables, sync direction and setup details for the Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks connectors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
